processing_note: Only processed places are listed. Each has radar dates, change products and a water series where the polarization exists.

places.name: dead_sea_east
places.title: Dead Sea - Jordanian east shore
places.story: The east shore between Suweimeh and Ghor Haditha, just north of the Lisan peninsula. Shoreline retreat as the lake level falls, and the sinkhole belt on the Ghor Haditha plain.
places.coord_note: Supplied by the team; valid as given.

places.name: dead_sea_full
places.title: Dead Sea - whole lake
places.story: The whole Dead Sea outline, both shores. Shows the lake as one object, including the evaporation ponds in the south, but at a coarser effective resolution per screen.
places.coord_note: Supplied by the team; valid as given. Large area (~30 x 60 km), so a subset window will be much bigger.

places.name: azraq_wetland
places.title: Azraq Wetland Reserve
places.story: A Ramsar wetland fed by groundwater, reduced by decades of abstraction. Small features relative to 20 m radar pixels, so this is a hard target.

places.name: alwehda_dam
places.title: Al-Wehda Dam
places.story: A large dam on the Yarmouk river. Water surface area responds to inflow and drawdown.

places.name: melehat_sdom
places.title: Melehat Sdom (southern Dead Sea)
places.story: The southern basin near Sdom, where the lake is shallowest and the shoreline has moved most.

places.name: potash_city
places.title: Potash City and surroundings
places.story: The potash industry area south of the Dead Sea: evaporation ponds, salt crust and plant infrastructure. Human-driven surface change, which the challenge explicitly welcomes.
places.coord_note: CORRECTED: longitudes were about -324.55; +360 applied. Large area (~15 x 30 km).

places.name: wadi_rum
places.title: Wadi Rum
places.story: Protected desert valley with sandstone massifs. Rock, sand and shadow, no water.
places.coord_note: Supplied by the team; valid as given.
